title: Delete the previous migration's one-time cleanup from import
outcome: Import knows nothing of the retired hash-identity design. It copies rows by column name, refuses an unknown table or column by name, keeps only the retired-column list as the schema-change mechanism, rebuilds the search indexes and runs the doctor. The build that can still convert the old-format backups is kept beside them.
acceptance: RETIRED_TABLES, RETIRED_ID_MAP, RETIRED_OBJECT_KIND, the reference-slot replacement, admit_pending_deliveries' materialization and PendingDelivery::Materialized are removed with their tests; a store from the previous design is refused by name like any other unknown table, and a staged page that omits the attribution the source proves is refused by name instead of supplied

the last build that still converts the old-format backups is stored beside them under ~/.engram/backups with a one-line note saying which stores it converts (engram-converter-5963d4d9e63e.exe, built from commit 91fec6d, with CONVERTER.txt)
the migration brief, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md no longer describe the one-time cleanup; all nine gates pass
the retired-column list and its tests remain the only named exception

completion.summary: Delivered in e073a12 (the deletion), with review follow-ups bc5aa00 and f35c207 on the same migration scope. Import knows nothing of the retired hash-identity design: RETIRED_TABLES, the old-id map, binding records, reference slots, per-row conversion and the pending-page materialization are gone; a table that design left behind is refused by name like any unknown table, and a staged page that disagrees with the source about the session's own changes is refused in either direction. The retired-column list is the only named exception. The last converting build (engram-converter-5963d4d9e63e.exe, from 91fec6d) sits beside the old-format backups with CONVERTER.txt. Migration brief, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md carry nothing of the cleanup. Nine gates green on every commit; reviewed in rounds 6 and 7 (both attested), findings fixed; Greg stopped the loop after round 7 and the last fixes landed as f35c207 (gates green, no further review by his decision).
